info.name: ECE1724 · Local CRUD review
info.description: Run the entire collection in order against the local development tester after backend-test:setup. Uses only its dedicated sandbox and generated recipe/image IDs; deletes its own successful test records. No sign-in credentials are needed. This fixed-identity tester does not prove product session authentication or public-recipe media access. Optional image lifecycle requests require runImageTests=true and Blob credentials configured on the server. See postman/README.md.

exec: if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1|\[::1\])(:\d+)?$/.test(base)) throw new Error("baseUrl must be a loopback HTTP origin with no trailing slash.");
pm.test("Owned list is bounded", () => { const rows=pm.response.json().recipes; pm.expect(rows).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(rows.length).to.be.at.most(50); });

item.name: 03 · Create private recipe with ordered ingredients and steps

exec: pm.test("Created recipe has a UUID and defaults to private", () => { pm.expect(recipe.id).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i); pm.expect(recipe.visibility).to.eql("PRIVATE"); });

pm.test("Quantities serialize as precise strings and notes survive", () => { pm.expect(recipe.baseServings).to.eql("4"); pm.expect(recipe.ingredients.map(x=>x.quantity)).to.eql(["400","1",null]); pm.expect(recipe.ingredients[2].note).to.eql("to taste"); });

pm.test("Ingredient and step order survives create", () => { pm.expect(recipe.ingredients.map(x=>x.name)).to.eql(["Flour","Eggs","Salt"]); pm.expect(recipe.steps.map(x=>x.instruction)).to.eql(["Mix the ingredients.","Bake the bread."]); });
pm.test("No storage paths or credential records leak", () => { pm.expect(recipe).not.to.have.any.keys("cover","author","pathname","password","session"); });

item.name: 04 · Read the created recipe by ID

exec: pm.test("Read returns the created recipe", () => { const r=pm.response.json().recipe; pm.expect(r.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("recipeId")); pm.expect(r.title).to.eql("Postman bread "+pm.collectionVariables.get("runId")); pm.expect(r.steps).to.have.lengthOf(2); });

item.name: 05 · Created recipe appears in owned list

exec: pm.test("Owned list contains the created ID", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().recipes.map(x=>x.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("recipeId")));

pm.test("All updated fields and ordered children persist", () => { const r=pm.response.json().recipe; pm.expect(r.baseServings).to.eql("6"); pm.expect(r.visibility).to.eql("PUBLIC"); pm.expect(r.ingredients.map(x=>x.name)).to.eql(["Salt","Flour","Eggs"]); pm.expect(r.ingredients.map(x=>x.quantity)).to.eql([null,"600.1","1.5"]); pm.expect(r.ingredients[1].note).to.eql("sifted"); pm.expect(r.steps.map(x=>x.instruction)).to.eql(["Sift, then mix.","Bake, then cool."]); });

item.name: 07 · Invalid update is rejected with field errors
08 · Rejected update leaves saved recipe unchanged

exec: pm.test("Previous data and children remain intact", () => { const r=pm.response.json().recipe; pm.expect(r.baseServings).to.eql("6"); pm.expect(r.title).to.eql("Updated bread "+pm.collectionVariables.get("runId")); pm.expect(r.ingredients.map(x=>x.quantity)).to.eql([null,"600.1","1.5"]); pm.expect(r.steps).to.have.lengthOf(2); });

item.name: 09 · Unknown cover is rejected without changing recipe
14 · Reject an unmeasured ingredient without a note
27 · Reject malformed multipart as a client error
28 · Require a file rather than a multipart text field
29 · Reject a file whose bytes are not an image
33 · Deleted recipe is absent from owned list

exec: pm.test("Metadata describes a private validated image", () => { pm.expect(image.id).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i); pm.expect(image.contentType).to.eql("image/png"); pm.expect(image.size).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(image).not.to.have.property("pathname"); });
pm.test("Image is served as PNG with nonempty bytes", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.include("image/png"); pm.expect(pm.response.responseSize).to.be.above(0); });
